Halfling shooter-spotter pairs armed with Threadbaum Model 1494-L 'Whisper' precision-rifle platform (suppressed, extended-range marksman configuration). Secondary weapons: Threadbaum 1494 pistol, hand crossbow for silent options. Mixed-race security elements (2-4 soldiers per pair) provide local protection. Nickname: 'The Quiet Company.' Organizational home: Bloodaxe Legion, Reconnaissance Division, Intelligence & Scouting Branch.

Standing reconnaissance and precision-fire element within the Bloodaxe Legion. Mission profile: long-duration concealed observation posts, precision elimination of high-value targets at range, intelligence collection via embedded community networks. Active deployment across Baen territory monitoring approach routes and competitor intelligence operations. Functions as halfling community service-pathway into the imperial security apparatus.

Created to solve two convergent problems: (1) no military career pathway optimized for halfling physiology in the existing Bloodaxe structure (line infantry requires mass, power armor requires minimum frame, the Veil selects on different criteria), and (2) the Reconnaissance Division's need for suppressed precision fire at extended range without compromising concealment. Halfling physical traits that are liabilities in a shield wall — smaller size, lighter footprint, natural quiet movement, cultural patience — are decisive advantages in scout-sniper roles. The spotter is the senior role; range estimation, wind reading via mirage, and target prioritization are harder skills than shooting. Unit structure: sniper pair (2 halflings, roles rotate) plus security element (2-4 mixed-race soldiers). Full doctrine preserved in source file.

Waterdeep noble-family cover (House Margaster); Asmodean infernal contracts and patronage; access to Waterdeep noble social networks; cell structure embedded within legitimate commercial and political operations.

Targeting Shi'van Baen'und specifically. Arik Baen does not currently know this cell is operational nor that it targets his brother. Forked soul-copy operators in commercially sourced constructed bodies (Dancer-class frames bought clean through factors). The COPY is the operator, bound by elven High Magic to an owner/original elsewhere. Full persons with full reflexes and lethality; bodies mimic living except for breath/relaxation. Soul-gems are the continuity point: destroyed frames can be replaced and the same copy can recur if its gem is recovered; gem destruction/severance is true death of that copy. Eldreth Veluuthra cell network and three centuries of tradecraft. Evermeet deniable-intelligence funding, cover, and rare/costly High Magic soul-forking. Cutout-based command insulates the Velharanil and Evermeet partner from captured operators.

Running continuing deception operations against Aldric Steelgaze, tempo set by the Evermeet senior partner. The Steelgaze Incident (Eleint 1495) — assassination of his intelligence chief Corvan Maelis by four forked-soul operators in serving cover, with a forged Baen-implicating dispatch carrying the Moonflower scent — is the latest and first-surfaced operation. One sheared body-plate left in Iron Sovereignty evidence (the plate-thread). Aldric's court has retold the operation as the duel-legend 'The Iron Sovereign's Dance,' inadvertently serving the Covenant's misdirection.

Joint-operations marriage of Eldreth Veluuthra (cells/violence) and Evermeet deniable intelligence (resources/cover/High Magic). The Moonflower name is targeted misdirection. SIGNATURE: forked soul-copies as autonomous operators in commercial Dancer-class bodies, bound by High Magic to owners/originals. Bodies are replaceable field hardware; the soul-gem carries the copy's continuity. If a frame is destroyed and the gem recovered, that same copy can return in another body. Destroying/severing the gem kills the copy; a living original, where one exists, remains separate. Some copies are uniquely vulnerable because their original is dead or because they fear oblivion. Operators can therefore recur, be captured as gem-prisoners, or potentially be turned if offered autonomous continuity. Steelgaze remains the first surfacing to Arik/Aldric-facing intelligence; the Flamerule Eye raid is GM-only prior chronology witnessed by independent Frieren.
